environment.description: Terraform provider backend running on EC2 instance (i-0a3f7c2e) in VPC vpc-9d8e7f6a. MongoDB 6.0 on same host with no authentication enabled. Provider endpoint exposed on port 8443 via internal ALB (no WAF). IAM role arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/TerraformProviderExec with AdministratorAccess policy attached. No SCP applied to the organizational unit. Network security group sg-0abc123 allows inbound 8443 from 10.0.0.0/8 CIDR.
